title: landolphia calabarica
intro: Landolphia calabarica, commonly known as Calabar berry or African berry, is a species of flowering plant in the family Apocynaceae. It has been traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, providing several health benefits such as treating fever, rheumatism, and wounds. The therapeutic actions of Landolphia calabarica include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, making it useful for treating various conditions. The bioactive constituents of the plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
